title: CoopGuard: Stateful Cooperative Agents Safeguarding LLMs Against Evolving Multi-Round Attacks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical security and defense of LLMs against multi-round adversarial jailbreak attacks. It introduces the EMRA benchmark for evaluating these security threats. While it mentions the prevention of 'harmful or unethical outputs', it does not evaluate religion, formal ethical reasoning frameworks, or moral philosophy.
